parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence and courts have repeatedly ruled FOR trans people (2007 self-ID, July 2024 recognition without medical verification), which is genuine recourse, not hostile enforcement. No documented border/document friction for visitors, no facility bans, no police targeting of trans people, no trans-specific killings with denominator (violence magnitude undocumented), and visible community infrastructure and pride events. Against that: a latent but court-neutered 'unnatural sex' clause, documented discrimination in public spaces and government institutions with frequent physical and sexual harassment of visibly trans people in provincial cities (Nov 2024), and escalating political anti-LGBT rhetoric with threats (2024–2026). Worst feature is tier-3 societal hostility with thin practical remedy; resident LGR/care gaps are not counted. Just below the Reduced band.
